design: Retrospective deliberately high-gain case selection from previously frozen Ictal Outer scores; not a representative case or independent confirmation.
eligibility: No minimum EZ count beyond both classes being present; retain >=20 total channels. Exclude the two previously selected cases. Require positive DREChanNet three-seed mean AUROC and Recall@10% changes, with at least two seeds jointly positive in both.
selection: Maximize J=(delta AUROC + delta Recall@10%)/2 for DREChanNet, with equal weights on their native 0-1 scales. Ties: maximize min(delta AUROC,delta Recall@10%); then number of jointly positive seeds; then fixed SHA256 identifier order. Do not change this rule after outcomes.
report: All five endpoints for SVM and all DRE seeds42/43/44 plus patient-endpoint seed mean; both gains and losses; cohort and eligible-pool midrank percentiles. SVM is reported but does not determine selection.
privacy: Only CASE-H01 and within-case CH aliases outside trusted server. True identities and contact names stay private.
